sbar.situation: The bank payment system has recovered. Two recovery checks in a row were clean, the last at 29 s, with the main payment journey completing and all components reporting metrics.
sbar.background: The gateway process went down with no release or config change recorded, so every payment journey timed out at the gateway step after 3.0 s. Separately, the clearing worker crashed on item 91 with 'JSONDecodeError: Expecting property name enclosed in double quotes' in self.parse(item), and its queue backed up behind that item.
sbar.assessment: There were two independent root causes: gateway process down (confidence 0.85) and a poison message on clearing (confidence 0.8). The incident commander itself restarted the gateway, which succeeded. It then quarantined clearing item 91 and restarted clearing, and both steps succeeded.
sbar.recommendation: The operations team has been escalated (soon) to review item 91, set aside from clearing, and either repair and resubmit it or close it with its customer. This payment has not been processed, so its money effect needs their review. Also find out why the gateway process went down, since no change was recorded.
